boundary_rows.even_nonzero: for kappa nonzero, the even-sheet variance is kappa^2 t^2/2
boundary_rows.kappa_zero: even ell gives I; odd ell gives R; momentum probabilities are stationary
boundary_rows.odd_period: U^2=I as an operator; individual states may already be one-step eigenstates
boundary_rows.odd_vector_phase: at kappa=0, |m> acquires (-1)^m under one odd-sheet kick although its ray and probability law are fixed
boundary_rows.operator_order: free-after-kick is frozen; the reversed product is not silently substituted

collision_boundary.C110: classical nonautonomous Henon Floquet dynamics, not a quantum rotor
collision_boundary.C143: coined quantum walk, not a cosine-kicked momentum lattice
collision_boundary.C148: open Walsh quantum baker, not a closed rotor unitary
collision_boundary.C178: harmonic metaplectic strobe, not the kicked-rotor parity sheet
collision_boundary.C224: two-level Landau--Zener scattering, not a kicked rotor
collision_boundary.C318: static SSH lattice, not a time-periodic rotor
collision_boundary.C323: finite continuous-time quantum search, not Floquet momentum transport

model.floquet_order: U_tau=exp(-i tau n_hat^2/2) exp(-i kappa cos(theta))
model.parameter_domain: kappa real, m integer, t nonnegative integer
model.resonance_sheet: tau=2pi ell with ell a positive integer

nonclaims: No literature-priority claim is made for resonance, antiresonance, or Bessel transport.
No general rational resonance, detuning, localization, or quasienergy theorem is claimed.
No target arithmetic datum, Euler factor, root number, automorphy, target divisor, functional equation, target-zero match, Hilbert--Polya operator, or Route-B input is claimed.

parameter_grid.time: 0..8 for moments and 0..9 for operator words

theorem_contract.boundaries: all m, kappa=0, t=0, parity, vector phase, and operator order are explicit
theorem_contract.characteristic: E exp(iu(n-m))=J_0(2 kappa t sin(u/2)) on the even sheet
theorem_contract.moments: centered moments through six and exact ballistic variance are explicit
theorem_contract.odd_involution: for odd ell, U=R K_kappa and U^2=I
theorem_contract.parity: even ell gives identity free factor; odd ell gives half-turn R
